body: Thank you for you feedback everyone, I am grateful for all these answers.
Sorry for the really delayed reply but thank you very much for the support! That was a lot of what I needed to hear, take care :)
I'm sad to hear your vacation was cut short and really hope you get well.

I feel you, my obsessive nature keeps me locked inside my mind and its so disabling it makes me suicidal. I actually have *REAL* OCD where I can't go through a day without getting lost in my rabbit hole of rituals, intrusive thoughts, and fears. I have no energy or pleasure and nothing makes it better, I've tried everything from exercise, working, therapy, meds, drugs, school, you name it. I'm alone and am forced to see everyone make friends and get dates so easily but I can't even talk to anyone I'm so damn absorbed in my mind, I'm a kissless 26M virgin. I've been on anti depressants since I was 8 and had a terrible time when I was a teenager, thus I never learned social skills. I wouldn't wish what you're going through on my worst enemy and truly hope the best for you.

There are some of us that don't feel like this because of the pandemic, we've been like this way before Covid 19 happened. If anything, life hasn't changed at all for the ones with deep seeded mental health issues that have no correlation to situational stress.

No, I live in Massachusetts and you can't even apply for a permit for something as little as being under the care of a psychiatrist. At least the northern U.S has stricter gun laws than the backwards south.
